source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information and detail information, then compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes a /redfish/v1/Chassis/FRU_CEML URI and returns three properties through insecure curl; it neither proves left-slot identity nor performs the source-required WebUI/IPMI comparison.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION adds left-module mapping, complete field parity and no-write controls, but incorrectly treats the required Project map/reference as a continuing review decision.

old_problem: Manufacturer, product and serial may be plausible for either side of a symmetric CEM assembly, and a friendly CEML name is not a durable physical association. The old review preserved the correct safeguards but did not convert left-slot binding, IPMI target and expected FRU contents into runtime configuration for an otherwise read-only deterministic test.
disposition_reason: Anchor FRU_CEML to the approved physical left CEM slot and durable module identity before selecting an IPMI FRU device or UI/API member, use CEMBB and CEMR only as negative controls against substitution, then compare every applicable raw/normalized FRU field with the left-module manufacturing authority. Required side/topology bindings are explicit Project prerequisites and do not require point-of-action confirmation.
decision_basis: XLSX row 953, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 954 were directly reviewed; the next pending identity was verified as Functionality row 954 / variant 9c9189addb8bcd8d.

The adjacent source row is FRU_CEMR. Left and right modules can legitimately share manufacturer, product and part values, so side identity must be demonstrated by an approved physical slot association plus a unique device/serial token rather than those common fields.

The IPMI FRU layout supplies Board/Product identity and optional custom fields but not universal Project left/right semantics. Side naming and resource-to-slot relationships therefore remain vendor/Project mappings while data decoding follows the standard format.
The Master explicitly requires actual BMC WebUI detail and `ipmitool fru print`; a Redfish member is corroborating evidence and cannot replace either interface.

ED-02, ED-08, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 require distinct identity, visual/audit evidence and retained logs; ED-33 through ED-38 permit safe parameterization and forbid guessed OEM resources or cross-case substitution.

test_case.test_name: Validate left CEM module FRU with side-bound WebUI/IPMI/Redfish parity
test_case.purpose: Verify the Project-defined physical left CEM module is uniquely bound to FRU_CEML, not CEMBB or FRU_CEMR, and that all applicable inventory/manufacturing data decode correctly and agree across its exact IPMI FRU record, actual BMC WebUI detail, mapped Redfish/OEM representation and authoritative left-module reference without mutation.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/chassis identity and approved physical CEM topology showing left, right and baseboard positions with durable service/slot/module associations
FRU_CEML IPMI FRU device ID, interface/channel/bridge/address parameters and complete enumerated device map; ID order is not a side map
Approved CEML resource relationships for Redfish Chassis/Assembly or OEM inventory and the actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs left-module row/detail
CEML-specific applicable FRU areas and required standard/custom field layout, including Board/Product fields, side/location extensions if present and rules for absent areas
Authoritative left-module manufacturing/BOM/asset record and permitted encoding, padding, blank, timestamp and freshness normalization
Trusted TLS, protected read-only credentials, evidence storage and stable-token redaction for serial, asset and internal topology identifiers
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify the immutable chassis and approved left/right/baseboard topology. Enumerate all IPMI FRU devices through the protected approved interface/channel/bridge, preserve the full list and select the CEML device only through the durable physical-left association; do not infer side from FRU ID ordering or a CEML label. Run only `ipmitool ... fru print <CEML-FRU-ID>` and preserve complete output, exit status and decoder/checksum diagnostics. Discover the mapped Redfish Chassis/Assembly or approved OEM member from links, and capture the actual rendered WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs CEML row and full detail. Record CEMBB and CEMR identifiers only as negative controls, without using their field values as CEML evidence. Decode all applicable Board/Product/Chassis/MultiRecord and custom fields, retain raw values, normalize only by the approved rules and compare each value with the CEML authority and across IPMI/UI/API. Repeat only read-only fingerprints; perform no FRU write/edit, log clearing, refresh, reset, reboot or power operation.
test_case.expected_result: One expected physical left CEM module maps uniquely to the chosen CEML IPMI device and approved UI/API member; the mappings do not resolve to CEMBB or CEMR. All applicable FRU areas decode without reported structure/checksum errors, every required standard/custom field is present or carries its approved absent representation, and raw-to-normalized values exactly match the left-module manufacturing authority and reconcile across the three evidence planes. No unexpected duplicate/extra/stale record or management/DUT state change occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires durable proof of the physical left-slot association, unique selection among the enumerated FRUs, full `ipmitool fru print`, actual WebUI visual detail, complete applicable-field comparison and exact authorized reference match. A CEML-shaped URI, ID position, common product data or three matching Redfish fields cannot prove side. Mapping to the right/baseboard, ambiguous or duplicate side binding, missing required field/area, parser/checksum failure, unauthorized blank or unexplained UI/IPMI/API/reference mismatch is FAIL. Missing side map, layout or expected record is NOT READY; unsupported/N/A requires authoritative platform evidence.
safety_gate: Use certificate-verified and protected read-only sessions; do not expose secrets in command arguments or accept insecure-TLS evidence.

Prove left-slot identity from the Project physical topology and durable device relationships before data comparison. Never infer CEML from alphabetical/numeric order or shared manufacturer/product/part values.
Restrict IPMI to FRU enumeration and `fru print` for the mapped device; prohibit write/edit/upgEkey, raw storage writes, log clear, BMC reset, reboot and power actions.
Keep CEMBB and CEMR identities as negative controls only; never copy expected or observed values between their independent source cases.
Capture the real rendered WebUI row/detail and preserve raw IPMI/API data before applying approved encoding, padding, blank or freshness normalization.
Stop on cross-side ambiguity, duplicate identifiers, stale caches, decode failure or authority conflict; preserve evidence and do not probe another FRU automatically.
expected_evidence: Target/chassis identity and approved physical CEM topology with stable left, right and baseboard tokens and explicit proof of the selected left-module association
Complete enumerated IPMI FRU list and timestamped `fru print <CEML-FRU-ID>` output with interface/channel/bridge, return code, decoder/checksum status and artifact hash
Discovered Redfish/OEM relationship chain and complete mapped CEML record with schema/firmware and certificate-validation metadata
Actual WebUI Inventory and LEDs CEML row/detail visual evidence plus negative-control identity tokens for CEMBB/CEMR
CEML-specific area/field matrix showing raw, normalized and expected values, normalization rule and individual outcome
Pre/post fingerprints, preserved SEL/audit logs, no-write/no-clear/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The test is read-only. If left/right/baseboard binding is uncertain, a required field cannot be decoded or evidence disagrees, stop and retain the protected artifacts, then obtain the authoritative CEM topology/layout/reference. Do not trial a neighboring FRU, rewrite inventory, clear logs, reset BMC, reboot or power-cycle, and do not automatically retry against a different module.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require the left CEM FRU and WebUI/IPMI correctness. Only the DeepSeek implementation is incomplete.

blocked.reason: The left-module comparison and side-substitution risk are well defined. Physical association, FRU layout and expected values are finite Project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Physical CEM left/right/baseboard topology; CEML IPMI device/channel/bridge; UI/API resource relationships; applicable areas/custom fields; left-module manufacturing reference; normalization, freshness and redaction rules.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY FRU_CEML REVIEW ONLY; NO IPMI, REDFISH, WEBUI OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
